nodes.summary: Let $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ and let $S = (x_1, \dots, x_k)$ be a sequence in $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. Then $S$ has an $A$-weighted zero-sum consecutive subsequence if there are indices $1 \le l \le h \le k$ and weights $a_l, \dots, a_h \in A$ with $\sum_{i=l}^{h} a_i x_i = 0$.
nodes.title: Consecutive weighted zero-sum subsequences

nodes.summary: Let $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ and let $S = (x_1, \dots, x_k)$ be a sequence in $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. Then $S$ has an $A$-weighted zero-sum subsequence if there are a nonempty set $J \subseteq \{1, \dots, k\}$ of indices and weights $a_i \in A$ for $i \in J$ with $\sum_{i \in J} a_i x_i = 0$.
nodes.title: Weighted zero-sum subsequences

nodes.summary: Let $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ and let $S = (x_1, \dots, x_k)$ be a sequence in $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. Then $S$ is an $A$-weighted zero-sum sequence if there are weights $a_1, \dots, a_k \in A$ with $a_1 x_1 + a_2 x_2 + \dots + a_k x_k = 0$.
nodes.title: Weighted zero-sum sequences

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an additive commutative monoid and $A$ a finite set of natural numbers. A finite sequence $s = (s_1, \dots, s_n)$ over $G$ is $A$-weighted zero-sum free when, for every non-empty set $I \subseteq \{1, \dots, n\}$ of positions and every choice of weights $a_i \in A$ for $i \in I$, the weighted sum $\sum_{i \in I} a_i s_i$ is non-zero, where $a_i s_i$ is the sum of $a_i$ copies of $s_i$. Terms are indexed…
nodes.title: Weighted zero-sum free sequences

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an additive commutative monoid, $A$ a finite set of natural numbers and $D_A(G)$ the $A$-weighted Davenport constant of $G$. If a sequence over $G$ of length $L$ is $A$-weighted zero-sum free, then $L < D_A(G)$.
nodes.title: Lower bound for the weighted Davenport constant

nodes.summary: Let $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. A natural number $a$ lies in the set of weight representatives of $A$ if and only if $a < n$ and the residue of $a$ modulo $n$ lies in $A$.
nodes.title: Membership in the weight representatives

nodes.summary: Let $A \subseteq B \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ and let $S$ be a finite sequence in $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. If $S$ has an $A$-weighted zero-sum subsequence, then $S$ has a $B$-weighted zero-sum subsequence.
nodes.title: Weighted zero-sum subsequences are monotone in the weight set

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $S(n)$ is the set of elements $x$ of $\mathbb{Z}_n = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ with $x \neq 0$ and $x = y^2$ for some $y \in \mathbb{Z}_n$.
nodes.title: Nonzero squares modulo $n$

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an additive commutative monoid and $A$ a finite set of natural numbers. If a sequence $s$ over $G$ is $A$-weighted zero-sum free, then for every $\ell \in \mathbb{N}$ the prefix of $s$ formed by its first $\ell$ terms (all of $s$ when $\ell$ is at least its length) is $A$-weighted zero-sum free.
nodes.title: Prefixes of weighted zero-sum free sequences

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $U(n)$ is the set of units of the ring $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ of integers modulo $n$.
nodes.title: Units modulo n

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $U(n)^2$ is the set of elements of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ of the form $u^2$ with $u$ a unit of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Squares of units modulo n

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number and $A$ a subset of $\mathbb{Z}_n = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. The $A$-weighted consecutive constant $C_A$ of $\mathbb{Z}_n$ is the least positive integer $k$ such that every sequence $(x_1, \dots, x_k)$ of elements of $\mathbb{Z}_n$ has a nonempty block of consecutive terms $x_i, \dots, x_j$ with weights $a_i, \dots, a_j \in A$ such that $a_i x_i + \dots + a_j x_j = 0$; it is $0$ when no…
nodes.title: Weighted consecutive zero-sum constant

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number and $A$ a subset of $\mathbb{Z}_n = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. This is the set of positive integers $k$ such that every sequence $(x_1, \dots, x_k)$ of elements of $\mathbb{Z}_n$ has a nonempty block of consecutive terms $x_i, \dots, x_j$ with weights $a_i, \dots, a_j \in A$ such that $a_i x_i + \dots + a_j x_j = 0$. Its least element, or $0$ when it is empty, is the $A$-weighted…
nodes.title: Lengths forcing a consecutive weighted zero sum

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an additive commutative monoid, $A$ a finite set of natural numbers and $D_A(G)$ the $A$-weighted Davenport constant of $G$. If there is a length $\ell \in \mathbb{N}$ such that no sequence over $G$ of length $\ell$ is $A$-weighted zero-sum free, then $D_A(G)$ is finite and equals the least such length.
nodes.title: The weighted Davenport constant as a least length

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an additive commutative monoid, $A$ a finite set of natural numbers and $D_A(G)$ the $A$-weighted Davenport constant of $G$. Then $D_A(G) = \infty$ if and only if for every $\ell \in \mathbb{N}$ there is an $A$-weighted zero-sum free sequence over $G$ of length $\ell$.
nodes.title: When the weighted Davenport constant is infinite

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an additive commutative monoid, $A$ a finite set of natural numbers, $D_A(G)$ the $A$-weighted Davenport constant of $G$ and $\ell$ a natural number. If no sequence over $G$ of length $\ell$ is $A$-weighted zero-sum free, that is, every sequence over $G$ of length $\ell$ has a non-empty $A$-weighted zero-sum subsequence, then $D_A(G) \le \ell$.
nodes.title: Upper bound for the weighted Davenport constant

nodes.summary: The ordinary Davenport constant of $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$, that is, its $\{1\}$-weighted Davenport constant, is $D_{\{1\}}(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}) = 2$.
nodes.title: Davenport constant of the group of order two

nodes.summary: For every non-empty finite set $A$ of natural numbers, the $A$-weighted Davenport constant of the trivial group $\mathbb{Z}/1\mathbb{Z}$ is $D_A(\mathbb{Z}/1\mathbb{Z}) = 1$.
nodes.title: Weighted Davenport constant of the trivial group

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an additive commutative monoid and $A$ a finite set of natural numbers. The $A$-weighted Davenport constant $D_A(G) \in \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$ is the least length $\ell \in \mathbb{N}$ such that no sequence over $G$ of length $\ell$ is $A$-weighted zero-sum free, that is, such that every sequence over $G$ of length $\ell$ has a non-empty $A$-weighted zero-sum subsequence; it is $\infty$ when no such…
nodes.title: Weighted Davenport constant

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number and $A$ a subset of $\mathbb{Z}_n$. The representatives of $A$ form the finite set of natural numbers $a$ with $0 \le a < n$ whose residue modulo $n$ lies in $A$.
nodes.title: Representatives of a set of residues
